"Sarah is available Mon–Wed, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, John is available Thu–Fri, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM"

calendarAI.messages.calendarTypesOvervie:
The platform supports these calendar types:

**1:1 Meeting** — Consults, coaching, discovery calls. 1 person per slot.

**Group Session** — Classes, webinars, workshops. Set a seat limit per slot.

**Team Rotation (Round Robin)** — Distribute bookings across team members automatically.

**Panel / Committee (Collective)** — All selected team members must attend together.

**Event** — Open registration for conferences, webinars, or RSVPs. No assigned host.

**Service Booking** — Clients pick a service and available staff member.

calendarSettings.description: Enable or disable calendar modules for all selected sub accounts in one go. Changes will apply uniformly across all selected sub accounts.
calendarSettings.meetingsDesc: Enable this option to allow sub accounts to use the meetings feature, designed for managing sales calendars, onboarding calls, round-robin scheduling, team collaborations, class bookings, interviews, and more. Ideal for businesses needing flexible and collaborative scheduling tools.
calendarSettings.rentalsDesc: Turn on rentals to give sub-accounts an end-to-end booking solution for rental asset-based businesses (such as vacation homes, vehicles, equipment, studios, spaces). Create listings with quantity and variants, offer hourly or multi-day bookings, set flexible pricing, accept payments or security deposits, and much more.
calendarSettings.servicesDesc: Turn on services to give sub accounts access to a complete booking solution for service-based businesses. This includes creating multiple services, managing resources, handling multiple locations, setting staff-specific pricing, adding service variations or add-ons, and more.
